timokles.name: Timokles
timokles.look: Greek young man, 19, lean rower's shoulders, sun-browned skin, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, clay under his fingernails, undyed off-white wool chiton belted at the waist, a small scar on one eyebrow, curious warm dark eyes

voice.name: Liam
voice.direction: young, warm, easy, understated; never theatrical

father.name: Damagoras
father.look: Greek man, 67, grey beard trimmed short, deep sun lines, heavy hands of a potter, faded blue-grey himation over a chiton, sits very straight, eyes that water at the dawn light

voice.name: Bill
voice.direction: old, slow, gravelly, tender, a man repeating a thing he loves

manes.name: Manes
manes.look: Phrygian man, 60, enslaved workshop hand, shaved head, grey stubble, wiry and strong, bare-chested with a leather apron, old burn scars on forearms, sardonic calm face

voice.name: George
voice.direction: dry, low, amused, unhurried; the wisest man in the film and he knows it

lysistratos.name: Lysistratos
lysistratos.look: Greek young man, 19, tall and thin as an oar, long jaw, messy light-brown hair, big grin, patched short chiton, rope calluses on his palms

voice.name: Charlie
voice.direction: quick, cheeky, affectionate, laughs inside his lines

merchant.name: The Merchant
merchant.look: Rhodian sea merchant, 45, heavy, salt-stained fine wool himation, gold ring, sunburnt bald head, furious and funny

voice.name: Daniel
voice.direction: exasperated, fast, grumbling; righteous about a law he hates

freedman.name: Philon the freedman
freedman.look: Syrian-born freedman, 55, dark oiled beard, rich saffron-bordered himation, a little too many rings, generous smile

kleino.name: Kleino
kleino.look: Greek girl, 16, sister of Timokles, dark hair bound up, ochre peplos, at an upright warp-weighted loom, concentrating

archaeologist.name: Archaeologist
archaeologist.look: only gloved hands of a modern archaeologist, blue nitrile gloves, soft brush, trowel
